response.title: which power station runs a hair dryer the longest
response.answer:
The power station that runs a hair dryer the longest is generally the one with the largest usable battery capacity (Wh), provided its AC inverter can handle the hair dryer's wattage.

Most hair dryers use 1,200–1,875 watts, so you'll want a power station with at least 2,000W of continuous AC output.

For comparison, I'll use a typical 1,500W hair dryer and assume 85% battery-to-AC efficiency.

Battery capacity

These are continuous-use estimates. Actual runtime depends on the hair dryer's heat and speed settings, battery condition, and inverter efficiency.
